definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."PurchaseOrder","d"."PurchaseOrderItem","d"."PurchaseOrderType","d"."PurchasingGroup","d"."PurchasingOrganization","d"."PurchasingDocumentOrigin","d"."Supplier","d"."SupplyingSupplier","d"."SupplyingPlant","d"."DocumentCurrency","d"."ExchangeRate","d"."InvoicingParty","d"."PurchaseOrderDate","d"."ValidityStartDate","d"."ValidityEndDate","d"."CreationDate","d"."LastChangeDateTime","d"."PurgDocumentItemDeletionCode","d"."MaterialGroup","d"."Material","d"."ManufacturerMaterial","d"."PurchaseOrderCategory","d"."PurchasingOrderReason","d"."PurchaseOrderItemText","d"."PurchaseOrderItemCategory","d"."CompanyCode","d"."Plant","d"."StorageLocation","d"."PurchaseContract","d"."PurchaseContractItem","d"."BaseUnit","d"."OrderQuantity","d"."PurchaseOrderQuantityUnit","d"."NetPriceAmount","d"."NetAmount","d"."LocalCurrency","d"."NetPriceQuantity","d"."OrderPriceUnit","d"."RequisitionerName","d"."RetailPromotion","d"."IsCompletelyDelivered","d"."IsReturnsItem","d"."IsFinallyInvoiced","d"."InvoiceIsExpected","d"."OrderItemQtyToBaseQtyDnmntr","d"."OrderItemQtyToBaseQtyNmrtr","d"."InvoiceIsGoodsReceiptBased","d"."GoodsReceiptIsExpected","d"."EvaldRcptSettlmtIsAllowed","d"."AccountAssignmentCategory","d"."GoodsReceiptIsNonValuated","d"."MaterialType","d"."OverdelivTolrtdLmtRatioInPct","d"."ServicePerformer","d"."TaxCode","d"."UnderdelivTolrtdLmtRatioInPct","d"."UnlimitedOverdeliveryIsAllowed","d"."SupplierMaterialNumber","d"."ProductTypeCode","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."ExpectedOverallLimitAmount","d"."OverallLimitAmount","d"."RequirementSegment","d"."ReleaseIsNotCompleted","d"."PurchasingCompletenessStatus","d"."IsStatisticalItem","d"."MultipleAcctAssgmtDistribution","d"."PurchaseRequisition","d"."PurchaseRequisitionItem","d"."SupplierConfirmationControlKey","d"."PurchasingDocumentDeletionCode","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_C_PURCHASEORDERITEMDEX_S4_CURR_Delta" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'C_PURCHASEORDERITEMDEX'
